name: ws-s3-poe-eth-8di-8do
title: Waveshare ESP32-S3-POE-ETH-8DI-8DO
notes: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U N16R8 (16 MB flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM, SMA antenna), 802.3af PoE built in. Same W5500 wiring as the 8DI-8RO: CS 16, INT 12, RST 39. Pins: Waveshare wiki, Waveshare Arduino demo (WS_ETH.h). The TF slot is SDMMC 1-bit only (CLK 48, CMD 47, D0 45, no CS), which the S3 image can't use: zones and blocking live in RAM only. Eight open-drain outputs, DI on GPIO4-11, RS485 and CAN on 17/18.
